result.summary: The image depicts a temporary roadway configuration, likely due to construction, that is entirely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crossings, or protected paths, forcing any pedestrians to navigate unpaved grassy areas or share the roadway with vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or physical barrier separating pedestrians from the travel lane on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Construction Zone Hazards
hazards.description: Temporary traffic control devices like barrels and signage are present without any clear guidance or safe passage for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Install a temporary, ADA-compliant walkway with physical separation (e.g., water-filled barriers) to provide safe passage through the construction zone.

interventions.title: Permanent Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a permanent, paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a curb or green buffer.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding Signage
interventions.description: Add clear signage directing pedestrians to the safest available route around the construction area.

result.summary: The image depicts a street intersection undergoing significant reconstruction, featuring a newly installed concrete curb extension and a modern street light pole. While the infrastructure is being upgraded, the environment currently lacks clear crosswalk markings and a continuous paved sidewalk on the left, with construction barriers creating temporary obstructions.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Orange and white striped barricades are positioned in the roadway and near the pedestrian path, potentially obstructing movement and sightlines.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The absence of clearly painted crosswalk markings at this intersection increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts during the construction phase.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility and define the pedestrian right-of-way once paving is complete.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install standard pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert approaching motorists to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Completion
interventions.description: Complete the paving of the sidewalk on the left side of the intersection to ensure a continuous and accessible pedestrian network.

result.summary: The image shows a street undergoing significant construction, with a newly paved sidewalk that is currently obstructed by traffic cones and signs. The lack of marked crossings and the presence of temporary barriers create a confusing and potentially hazardous environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction cones and signage completely block the newly paved pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, foreground and midground

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk or pedestrian signals are visible to facilitate safe crossing of the active travel lane.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Establish a clear, barricaded path for pedestrians to bypass the construction area safely.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way once the road surface is finalized.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring multiple rail tracks and a roadway without any visible designated crossings or sidewalks. Pedestrians are forced to navigate across tracks and along unpaved areas, creating significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Unprotected Rail Crossing
hazards.description: Multiple sets of rail tracks lack a designated pedestrian crossing, signals, or gates, posing a severe collision risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the middle ground of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of sidewalks or paved paths forces pedestrians to walk on uneven gravel or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the distant roadway.

interventions.title: Signalized Pedestrian Rail Crossing
interventions.description: Install a designated crossing with active warning lights and gates to safely manage pedestrian movement across the tracks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk network with ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide safe separation from vehicles and trains.
